title: Refund policy
body: Refunds for double charge or duplicate charge errors are reviewed by billing within 1 business day. Approved refunds return to the original card in 5-7 days.

title: Returns
body: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from your orders page; the refund is issued after the item arrives.

title: Shipping times
body: Standard shipping takes 3-6 business days. Express takes 1-2 days. Delayed shipments are investigated by the shipping team after 7 days.

title: Tracking an order
body: Every shipped order has a carrier and tracking status. Status in_transit means the carrier has the package; delayed means the ETA slipped.

title: Password reset
body: If you cannot log in, request a password reset link. Account access issues the reset cannot fix are handled by the account team.

title: Two-factor authentication
body: Two-factor codes expire after 5 minutes. Lost devices require identity verification by the account team.

title: Cancel a subscription
body: Subscriptions can be cancelled anytime. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period; no partial refunds.

title: Plans
body: Basic and Pro plans differ in support hours and storage. Upgrades are prorated; downgrades apply next billing period.

title: Invoices
body: Monthly invoices are emailed on the 1st. Billing can resend an invoice or correct invoice details on request.

title: Payment methods
body: We accept cards and bank transfer. Never share full card numbers in chat; support will never ask for them.

title: Damaged items
body: Report damaged items within 7 days with a photo. A replacement or refund is issued after review.

title: Contacting support
body: Support is available 24/7 in chat. Specialists for billing, account, and shipping handle escalated cases.
